evidence.reason: After edit contains 'rereturn reminders.evaluate(...)', which is invalid syntax and prevents the module from compiling.
Default parameter changed from configuration.rate to 0, so callers relying on the configured rate (including evaluate and tests expecting positive delays) get different results.
evaluate value-references reminderDelay; with multiplier defaulting to 0, priorities[0] becomes 0 and the computed delay changes, violating the test expectation that evaluate(20, 0.1, 'work') > 0.
Tests assert evaluate(20, 0.1, 'work') > 0 and scheduledDelay(40) > 0; the left syntax error breaks scheduledDelay and the right default change can make evaluate return non-positive values.

result.userExplanation: 左侧改动把 scheduledDelay 写成了语法错误的 'rereturn'，右侧改动又把 reminderDelay 的默认 multiplier 从 configuration.rate 改成 0，两者合并后既无法编译又改变了依赖默认配置的延迟计算行为。
result.suggestedAction: 请将 src/scheduling.ts 中 scheduledDelay 的 'rereturn' 改回 'return'，并将 src/reminders.ts 中 reminderDelay 的默认参数 multiplier 恢复为 configuration.rate。
